answer: An oasis of trusted identity emerges because forging thousands of fake participants costs real energy and capital, making it uneconomical. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work plus stake: each new agent must burn verifiable compute and lock a bond before joining. A whisper of collusion triggers slashing of bonded stake, and a willow-like reputation tree grows only from sustained honest participation, so attackers face escalating losses. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
